messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: unusual cross-region routing detected for endpoint /v2/stream.  traffic from us-east is shifting to ap-southeast-1, error rate climbed from 0.1% -> 2.3%. latency p95 jumped. threshold triggered.
emma_oncall: ack. starting bridge and paging network + runtime. can someone pull first look at steering decisions?
jordana_neteng: looking at steering-eval traces. we see an AZ-level DNS TTL propagation mismatch: one us-east AZ returned stale geo-affinity = ap region for a subset of IPs. the latency aggregator then favored ap-southeast for those client IPs due to a transient RTT dip.
tom_runtime: any recent change in steering weights or smoothing windows? we pushed an adjustment earlier today to prefer short-term RTT (smoothing window 10s -> 5s). could amplify transient dips.
emma_oncall: deploy-bot, show recent routing policy changes.
deploy-bot: routing policy push 0x8f3d deployed at 2401239805 by jordana_neteng: reduced smoothing window and updated tie-break strategy to prefer lower recent RTT.
jordana_neteng: yep that aligns. rolling smoothing earlier made system chase ephemeral path improvements.
lee_sre: cloud-support: any fabric issues or DNS service alarms?
cloud-support: provider NOC reports elevated DNS update propagation latencies in us-east-1 region around 2401239900-2401240300, some AZ DNS servers returning old zone data due to config sync delays. investigating.
emma_oncall: mitigation proposal: 1) disable recent smoothing change (rollback policy 0x8f3d). 2) turn off latency-steering for /v2/stream temporarily (fallback to geo). 3) set region_override for us-east while provider stabilizes. anyone object?
omitted: (no objections from channel)
jordana_neteng: executing rollback now: ```
# routingctl rollback --policy 0x8f3d
# routingctl disable-latency-steering --service "/v2/stream"
# routingctl set region_override --service "/v2/stream" --origin us-east --ttl 600
```
(edited) jordana_neteng: rollback and overrides applied at 2401240120. monitoring.
ops-bot: Change recorded: rollback policy 0x8f3d by jordana_neteng at 2401240120.
tom_runtime: after override, p50 from 120ms -> 35ms, p95 from 900ms -> 140ms for the affected cohort. errors dropped to baseline within ~75s.
emma_oncall: thanks. can we get customer impact estimate and which product surfaces were impacted?
lee_sre: ingress logs: ~45,200 requests directed to ap-southeast during window 2401239850-2401240120. ~2,450 returned 5xx. impacted customers: streaming-realtime and webhook-heavy integrations.
jordana_neteng: creating incident summary for support: "Intermittent DNS propagation delay in us-east AZs led to stale geo-affinity responses. A recent routing policy tightening (shorter smoothing window) amplified transient RTT dips, causing latency-based steering to prefer AP origin for some US clients. We rolled back the policy and applied a regional override. Provider NOC investigating DNS propagation issue."
emma_oncall: add timeline, include deploy hash and rollback hash, attach Grafana and ingress logs. Also flag policy 0x8f3d for a change review.
cloud-support: provider NOC indicates config sync backlog on dns-control for us-east AZ-2. they estimate 30-45m to fully catch up; suppression in progress.
tom_runtime: additional item: KV prefix tagging. if we change origin we might get KV cache misses causing backend errors. we should clear region-tagged cache keys for the streaming session namespace. executing: ```
# kvctl clear --prefix "stream-session:region_tag" --origin ap-southeast || true
```
(edited) tom_runtime: cleared stale region-tagged keys.
emma_oncall: handoff note for next on-call: rollback completed (policy 0x8f3d reverted), latency-steering disabled for /v2/stream, region_override us-east set (ttl 600). provider investigating DNS sync backlog. continue override until provider confirms stability or we observe 30m of steady telemetry. please monitor streaming p95 and 5xx.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2402 created and acknowledged; bridge closed at 2401240680. reminder: attach logs and assign postmortem owner.
deploy-bot: note: policy 0x8f3d touched smoothing_window and tie-break logic. rollback ID 0x8f3d-rollback. please include tests for TTL/DNS anomalies in the change checklist.
jordana_neteng: taking postmortem ownership. planned actions: vendor RCA, change-review for smoothing window defaults, add guardrail to prevent <10s smoothing unless explicit canary, add health-check that falls back to geo-affinity on DNS anomaly detection.
emma_oncall: thanks team. sending customer-facing blurb to support: "We experienced a transient routing incident impacting streaming endpoints due to DNS propagation delays in a us-east AZ combined with a recent routing policy change. We reverted the policy and applied a temporary override; the issue is now mitigated. We're investigating and will follow up with a postmortem."
emma_oncall: handing off to jordana_neteng for overnight follow-up. jordana, update incident doc when provider confirms. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: checklist opened: attach ingress logs, steering-eval traces, deploy diffs, provider NOC ticket.
ops-bot: bridge closed at 2401240680.
